svg.title: Theseus: the development timeline, from conception to now, and what is ahead
svg.desc: A horizontal timeline from September 23, 2026, when the idea was written down, to October 8, 2026, with the phases of the build as coloured bands, commits per day as bars, sixteen dated callouts, and six planned items ahead, undated.
